verdict.rationale: There's no explicit documentation of a bulk 'export all data' feature or open-format data portability; however, QuickBooks does expose a REST API, official SDKs (Node/PHP), and an MCP server with 'complete coverage' of the QBO API, which could technically be used to extract all data programmatically. No OpenAPI spec or llms.txt was discoverable (404s), limiting AI-native self-service export.
